check.whyText: A recruiter spends 15 to 30 seconds on a CV, and many companies sort with software first. These rules make your CV easy to read for both.
check.noSuggestion: No suggestion for now: fix it yourself.
check.noFigure: The AI can’t know your figure: add it yourself in the line.
check.warnNewNumbers: Check the numbers: the proposal contains a number that is not in your text
check.warnTooLong: Proposal much longer than your text, shorten it if needed

actions.useNumber: Use this, I’ll add the figure

contact_details.title: Phone, professional email, city and country
contact_details.why: Recruiters need to reach you quickly. Give your city and country, never your full address.

no_personal_details.title: No age, nationality or marital status
no_personal_details.why: They do not help judge your skills and can create bias.

profile_links.title: LinkedIn and GitHub or portfolio links
profile_links.why: A link shows your work to the recruiter in one click.

photo.title: A photo only where it is expected
photo.why: Usual in Tunisia and France, avoided in the United States and the United Kingdom. If you add one: plain background, professional outfit, light smile, shoulders slightly turned.

summary.title: A 2 to 5 line summary that adds something
summary.why: Say who you are, your best result and one or two key skills. Do not repeat the rest of the CV.

action_verbs.title: Every line starts with a past-tense verb
action_verbs.why: It reads as an action and all lines look alike.

quantified_results.title: Show results with numbers
quantified_results.why: Say what you did, what changed and how you measured it.

short_bullets.title: Lines of two lines at most
short_bullets.why: Short lines are read, long ones are skipped.

number_style.title: Numbers under 10 in words, 10 and above in digits

reverse_chronological.title: Most recent first, with full dates
reverse_chronological.why: Recruiters look at your latest experience first. Write “present” for what is ongoing.

graduation_year.title: Graduation year, or expected year
graduation_year.why: For a final-year internship, the company knows when you finish your degree.

gpa.title: Your grade only if it helps you
gpa.why: Show your average only if it is 15/20 or more (GPA 3.0 or more).

local_diplomas.title: Degrees the target country understands
local_diplomas.why: Applying abroad? Use the local equivalent, for example “A-levels” in the United Kingdom for the baccalauréat.

no_skill_ratings.title: No stars, bars or percentages
no_skill_ratings.why: Nobody can check a self-rating. Let your experience show your level.

relevant_skills.title: Only skills you can talk about in an interview
relevant_skills.why: Technical skills first, then a few qualities. Remove what you only touched once.

certifications.title: Certifications section
certifications.why: An expected section. Add a course or a certificate if you have one, even online.

one_page.title: One page
one_page.why: With less than 5 years of experience, one page is the rule.

fonts.title: One font, 10 to 12 pt for text, 12 to 14 pt for titles

colors.title: Mostly black on white, one accent colour
colors.why: Companies often print in black and white. Keep colour for titles.

bold_titles.title: Bold for titles and names, no underline
bold_titles.why: Bold guides the eye; underline and heavy italics make text harder to read.

file_name.title: File named firstname_lastname.pdf
file_name.why: Recruiters keep hundreds of files. Your name must be in the file name.

pdf_size.title: PDF under 1 MB
pdf_size.why: Some company software refuses large files.

company_language.title: Same language as the company
company_language.why: French for Tunisia and France, English for most other countries.
